lead: Tom Cruise is a widely followed American film actor, born on 3 July 1962 in Syracuse.
As of 2026, he is 64 years old, and his birth date places him under the Cancer sign.

He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama and Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Musical or Comedy.
This profile collects the Tom facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Tom Cruise — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Tom Cruise was born on 3 July 1962 in Syracuse, and holds American nationality. He was given the name Thomas Cruise Mapother IV at birth and is publicly known as Tom Cruise.
Public records name his father, Thomas Cruise Mapother III and his mother, Mary Lee Pfeiffer.
He received his education at Henry Munro Middle School, Glen Ridge High School and St. Xavier High School.
He is recorded as speaking English.
